queries.title: Company queries
queries.description: One to 25 evidence queries. Prefer the exact nine-digit organisation number. A supplied name alongside an organisation number is returned as a consistency check, never as a replacement identifier.

reference.title: Caller reference
reference.description: Optional non-sensitive caller reference bound into the evidence receipt.

name.title: Entity name
name.description: Bounded official name search. The API's published candidates are returned; ambiguous candidates are not silently resolved.

purpose.title: Evidence purpose
purpose.description: Caller-declared workflow context recorded in the receipt; it never changes source facts or produces an eligibility verdict.

previousDecisionReceiptHash.title: Previous decision receipt
previousDecisionReceiptHash.description: Optional prior SHA-256 decision receipt used only for deterministic change classification.

previousRecordReceipts.title: Previous record receipts
previousRecordReceipts.description: Optional prior record receipt hashes used only for deterministic added, removed, or unchanged classification.

maxRecords.title: Maximum returned name candidates
maxRecords.description: Name searches request one additional record internally so truncation is detected and disclosed.

batchReference.title: Batch reference
batchReference.description: Optional non-sensitive batch reference bound into the shared batch receipt.
